{{Quote|Next batch at 0600, General Cracken.|Fourdee|<ref name="SWGK" />}}
'''Fourdee''' was a [[Secretary droid/Legends|receptionist droid]] with a tinny, [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] voice who served as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken's]] [[Secretary/Legends|secretary]] during the Alliance's [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the Rebel victory at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Fourdee admitted the Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] recruits [[Carns Capra]], [[Denis Rygelli]], [[Ben Spax]], and [[Trinna Orani]] to be briefed by Cracken. The general found the task taxing and grew angry with Fourdee when the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] reminded him of an upcoming meeting with another batch of recruits.<ref name="SWGK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fourdee appeared in "[[The Bissillirus Campaign]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] campaign for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was first published in the [[1991]] ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Kit]]'' supplement written by [[Bill Smith]] and [[Ed Stark]].<ref name="SWGK" />
